name: Geo. Wilder
role: Iowa visitor traveling to the Black Hills
bio: George Wilder and his wife, of Iowa, passed through Medora for the Black Hills in July 1885. They came back in August 1885 with John Beers.

moments.label: Returned from the Black Hills with John Beers

mentions: …knife camp; Max Bass, Bismarck; H. H. Delong, Canton, Dak.; B. F. Reynolds, Texas; A. Goodkind Bismarck; Geo. Wilder and wife, Mt. Pleasant, Iowa; S. Riddle, Waverly, Neb.; J. L. Truscott and wife, Medora; J. J. Graham, C. H. Skilton, St. Paul.
J. F. B[e?]ers started yesterday morning with Mr. and Mrs. Wilder, of Iowa, for the Black Hills.
John Beers returned last Friday from the Hills, with Geo. Wilder and wife, of Mt. Pleasant, Iowa.
